Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class ReservoirStateWellBinding

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.ReservoirStateWellBinding
public final class ReservoirStateWellBinding extends Object
Applies a simulator-derived reservoir state to an existing production WellSystem.

The binding is deliberately not a network or a scheduler. Call apply() before solving the existing FieldWellNetworkCoupler; advance the proxy explicitly with ReservoirStateModel.produce(double, double, double), ReservoirStateModel.inject(double, double) and ReservoirStateModel.elapse(double). The configured inlet stream object is retained so the well remains connected to the canonical process and field topology.
